outline: This course aims to provide pre-service management students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.
schedule: The detailed schedule will be distributed on the first day of class.
assessment:
1.School-wide English Proficiency Test: 20%
2.Attendance 20% (7% reduction per absence; Five unexcused absences from class will result in automatic failure of the course)

Please provide a valid proof of illness (medical certificate or record of hospitalization) within 10 days of the date of absence.

3.In-Class Performance & Assignments 40%
4.Presentation (Peer Evaluation) 20 %
